tasks.label: Rev-C: KiCad ERC
tasks.detail: Read-only ERC report to build_kicad/ (Rev-C files unchanged)
args: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force build_kicad | Out-Null; $k = (Get-Command kicad-cli -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $k) { $k = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\KiCad\10.0\bin\kicad-cli.exe" }; & $k sch erc --severity-all -o build_kicad/revc-erc.rpt hardware/kicad/dsp-regulator-hat-rev-c/DSP-Regulator-HAT-RevC.kicad_sch

tasks.label: Rev-C: Export netlist
tasks.detail: Fresh netlist to build_kicad/ for comparison with committed .net
args: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force build_kicad | Out-Null; $k = (Get-Command kicad-cli -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $k) { $k = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\KiCad\10.0\bin\kicad-cli.exe" }; & $k sch export netlist -o build_kicad/revc-fresh.net hardware/kicad/dsp-regulator-hat-rev-c/DSP-Regulator-HAT-RevC.kicad_sch
